This page shows the source file of the exercise below. Use the button to download it as a
plain file and run it in your own workspace.

[Download source (Qmd)](_source/04-Model-Exercises.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
src <- "_source/04-Model-Exercises.qmd"
txt <- readLines(src, warn = FALSE)
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
cat(paste0('<pre class="source-view"><code>', paste(esc(txt), collapse = "\n"), '</code></pre>'))
```
